snippet.title: Two Point Campus: School Spirits | Coming March 15th!
snippet.description:
Announcing the brand new spooktacular DLC for Two Point Campus. 

Welcome to Lifeless Estate! Haunted by unwelcome and undead spirits, the estate needs your help for a new lease on the afterlife. 

Featuring two spirited new courses, a fiendish new challenge mode level, and lots of hauntingly good items. 

Tackle the paranormal pest problem, learn what it means to be dead and help the estate rest, peacefully, once again.
